note: Phase-2 sample: 1 KPI per group (G1-G7). Same shortlist is compared under each active criterion.

indicators.name: Primary Energy
indicators.description: Total primary energy use of the building (overall energy performance, easy comparison across buildings).

indicators.name: Flexibility Factor
indicators.description: Ability of the building to shift or modulate load in response to grid/market signals.

indicators.name: RES Self-consumption (Supply Cover Factor)
indicators.description: Share of on-site renewable generation consumed in the building (energy independence proxy).

indicators.name: Increased reliability
indicators.description: Reliability of the energy system after renovation (fewer failures and supply interruptions).

indicators.name: Consumer Engagement
indicators.description: Extent to which users are informed, involved and able to act on building performance.

indicators.name: CO2 concentration
indicators.description: Indoor CO2 concentration as a practical proxy for indoor air quality and ventilation.

indicators.name: Net Present Value (NPV)
indicators.description: Life-cycle economic value of the renovation (discounted benefits minus costs).
